scope: Full-schedule FLIRT bugfix and fused-GPU execution; paired real-data FSL oracles, scalar summaries only
precision: Float32 image/cost tensors, double small affine matrices and NMI histogram accumulation; TF32 enabled globally; fused sampling uses explicit round-to-nearest float32 operations without FMA or FTZ; no FP16/BF16
schedule: Unchanged default 8/4/2/1 mm schedule and angular candidate set. Header pixdim now correctly enables the genuine 1-mm public reference level; 6-DOF still uses default search12 initialization.
runtime_dependencies: PyTorch, nibabel, NumPy; optional Triton 3.1 already included in environment.yml. FSL is an offline validation oracle only.

fixes.cause: Affine column norms were incorrectly used as FSL sampling distances. Public header pixdim=1 versus affine minimum=1.0000000213913103 made ceil choose 2.
fixes.change: Use header pixdim for search, scaled-mm transforms and resampling; both artifacts in displacement scoring use their header pixdim.
fixes.public_ablation: Header-only correction lowers RMS from 0.372083915 to 0.013525318 mm.

fixes.change: Restore NMI raw-centre/neighbour clamp ordering, near-zero joint entropy, assigned bin-factor/offset arithmetic; CorrRatio second-moment multiplication and double-complement rounding.
Restore schedule zero-perturbation decomposition/recomposition and assigned float thresholds, angle perturbations, RMS pruning, stopping average and Brent minimum-distance rounding.

Invert/compose small transforms in double then sample in float32; restore NEWIMAGE edge-background, output dtype and reference pixdim; registration fills a missing qform/sform while applyxfm preserves reference form codes; static-index final sampling.

Fuse affine coordinates, eight-corner trilinear sampling and edge weights; preserve corrected tensor-path arithmetic, candidate ordering, reduction layout, iterations and search scope. CPU/weighted sampling falls back to tensors.

metric_definition.matrix: 13^3 world-grid points spanning moving FOV; forward scaled-mm matrices converted using header pixdim on both sides; mean/median/p95/RMS in mm. Recomputed older scores retain original timing and tool hashes.
metric_definition.image: Pearson/MAE/RMSE on unchanged official output foreground; intensity MAE in original image units; support Dice over all nonzero output voxels.
metric_definition.cost: Final FNIT cost; the official default log does not expose an identical internal cost summary.
